hardware.gpu_assignment: One timing process per GPU with device and software versions recorded.
hardware.contention_policy: Never place two timing processes on one GPU.

timed_interval.excluded: Dataset loading, disk cache loading, and split construction before synchronization.
timed_interval.included_start: Before method-specific ranking/mask generation, or before model initialization for Full and EHGNN-F.
timed_interval.included_end: After early-stopped training, best-checkpoint restoration, and final evaluation.
timed_interval.synchronization: Synchronize the assigned GPU around every timed interval.
timed_interval.epoch_normalization: Fit plus final evaluation divided by epochs run; preprocessing is separate.

implementation_equivalence.mask_rule: Random-Fixed and stored structural masks must be bitwise identical. EHGNN-F must meet the declared reference-mask Jaccard threshold.
implementation_equivalence.accuracy_rule: Test accuracy must equal the stored reference result within 1e-6 accuracy point.
implementation_equivalence.budget_rule: Sparse methods retain exactly max(1,floor(rho*t)) original incidences and all methods receive N fixed self-loops.
implementation_equivalence.failure_rule: Reject failures of mask criterion, accuracy, budget, fixed-self-loop, finite-metric, or forward-count equivalence.

structural_mask_policy.classifier_timing: Use the exact stored Degree/Spectral accuracy-study mask.
structural_mask_policy.ranking_timing: Recompute score-plus-prefix construction separately inside the preprocessing interval.
structural_mask_policy.ranking_reproduction_diagnostic: Report exact equality and Jaccard between recomputed and stored masks.
structural_mask_policy.figure_scope: The main per-epoch panel excludes preprocessing.

ehgnnf_mask_policy.rationale: At the smallest Yelp budget this threshold permits at most approximately two boundary swaps among 452,359 retained incidences; the inspected deviation was one swap.

reporting.aggregation: Mean and sample standard deviation over three model seeds.
